title: introduce credential aliasing, compact stream facade, and retry presets across SDKs
author: Leah Morrison
description:
Motivation: Several teams reported friction when rolling credential changes and SDK upgrades in mixed-language environments. This PR introduces a small, focused compatibility layer plus ergonomics improvements to reduce migration effort and stabilize streaming surface parity across Python/TS/Go.

Summary of changes (single-pass):
- Add credential aliasing registry: a runtime shim that maps logical credential names (eg 'service-batch-writer') to concrete providers. This lets customers rotate or shadow credentials without code changes in callers across SDKs.
- Introduce a compact stream facade (pull-generator friendly) that standardizes resume tokens, heartbeat hints, and idempotent checkpointing. Surface is intentionally minimal: open(), nextChunk(), resume(token).
- Harmonize retry presets: add two named profiles ("latency-sensitive" and "throughput-optimal") and wire them into SDK defaults. Each preset is documented with concrete backoff/jitter parameters used by the service-side router.
- Bump SDK versions to align: py 1.12.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.5.3 and update changelogs and compatibility matrix.
- Add migration guide and cross-SDK examples demonstrating alias registry usage and stream resume semantics.

Why this shape: The aliasing approach avoids embedding credential URLs/keys in multiple layers and enables canary/blue-green credential swaps. The compact stream facade gives apps a predictable, language-agnostic resume model (important for mobile, serverless and long-running consumers).

Compatibility notes and migration steps:
1) Install SDK bumps (links in docs) – default behavior is backward-compatible; alias registry is opt-in via a single small config block.
2) If you relied on SDK-specific stream resume tokens previously, switch to the new compact facade by calling .resume(token) — the facade accepts old tokens and translates where possible, but opaque tokens from proprietary shims may require a short migration step (outlined in migration guide).
3) Retry preset names are additive; existing custom retry configurations are unaffected.

Testing done:
- Unit tests added across py/ts/go for alias lookup, token translation and retry profile selection.
- Integration test harness validated stream resume across a simulated router with deliberate token expiry and credential rotation.
- End-to-end perf check: latency-sensitive retry preset reduced P99 latency by ~8% on short requests in our benchmark lab when compared to the previous default for small-message workloads.

Checklist:
- [x] credential alias registry implementation (py/ts/go)
- [x] compact stream facade implementation and docs
- [x] retry preset definitions and SDK wiring
- [x] migration guide and examples
- [x] unit/integration tests and CI green
- [x] changelogs and version bumps

Related: ENG-1842 (credential lifecycle), ENG-1978 (stream resume parity), SUP-9021 (customer support case that motivated aliasing).

review_threads:
Arjun Patel (2025-11-09): Can you clarify the guarantees for token translation when the upstream router drops metadata? Also request adding an explicit test where token translation fails and we provide a helpful error.
Leah: Added translation-failure test and a more descriptive error message; included failure case in docs.

Maya Chen (2025-11-14): The TS facade API looks ergonomically better but we lost a minor type-safety hint on the resume token shape. Suggest we expose a ResumeToken type alias in the public index.
Leah: Added ResumeToken export and updated examples. CI caught a missing export which is fixed in commit 'feat(ts): export ResumeToken'.

Sophie Alvarez (2026-01-21): Concern about alias registry defaulting to environment variable lookup causing surprising behavior in serverless. Recommend explicit opt-in via SDK config.
Leah: Changed default to opt-out (registry disabled unless configured). Updated migration guide to highlight this change.

Arjun Patel (2026-02-12): Last pass — re-run CI and minor nits in docs. Approve after CI green.
Maya Chen (2026-02-13): Approve.
Sophie Alvarez (2026-02-13): Approve.
CI (2026-02-13): initial run failed (flake in tests/integration/stream_resume_rotation_test.ts). Flake fixed by adding deterministic seed in test harness. Final CI (2026-02-14): all checks passed.
release_notes: Added credential alias registry (opt-in), compact stream facade (resume tokens + heartbeat hints), and two named retry presets (latency-sensitive, throughput-optimal). SDKs bumped: py 1.12.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.5.3. See docs/migration/credential-aliasing.md for migration steps.
notes_for_backport: Backport candidate for maintenance branches: include alias registry plumbing and retry presets only; defer stream facade backports due to contract changes. When backporting ensure changelog entries and test harness seeds are included.
